name: Enthusiasm
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of wholehearted and diligent service to the Lord, encouraging believers to work with all their might and to be fervent in spirit as part of their reasonable worship. The wisdom literature warns against acting hastily without knowledge, highlighting the danger of sin when enthusiasm is not tempered by understanding. Furthermore, God calls for sincere and faithful labor, condemning negligent or deceitful efforts in His work. This balanced zeal reflects a commitment to serve God with both passion and wisdom.
